extends CharacterBody2D
## Base tank (YunqiZ and the enemy tanks): hull that faces the movement direction, turret that
## faces the aim, 8 facings from 5 generated directions (3 mirrored), health with visible damage
## states, reload, recoil and destruction.

signal fired(tank)
signal damaged(tank, amount)
signal destroyed(tank)

const SIN_E := 0.8192            # sin(55 deg): vertical squash of the oblique view
const TURRET_OFFSET := Vector2(0.0, -10.85)  # turret pivot above the hull origin, display px
const BARREL_LEN := 40.4         # barrel tip distance from the pivot (0.78 units), display px
const RADIUS := 16.6             # collision circle: half the hull width
# Facing slots clockwise from screen-right (y points down): texture name and mirror flag.
const SLOT_TEX := ["right", "down_right", "down", "down_right", "right", "up_right", "up", "up_right"]
const SLOT_FLIP := [false, false, false, true, true, true, false, false]

enum Motion { IDLE, MOVING }
enum Weapon { READY, FIRING }
# Phase table of the `shoot` clip (brief): 30 fps, shell on frame 1, weapon READY again at frame 5.
const SHOOT_FPS := 30.0
const SHOOT_ACTIVE_FRAME := 1
const SHOOT_END_FRAME := 5
const DUST_BEHIND := 14.0        # display px behind the tank; a guess, human check

@export var team := "player"
@export var max_health := 100
@export var speed := 110.0
@export var reload_time := 0.8
@export var shell_damage := 25
@export var tint := Color(1, 1, 1)

var world = null
var health := 100
var is_dead := false
var reload_left := 0.0
var invuln_left := 0.0
var aim_angle := 0.0
var move_dir := Vector2.ZERO
var recoil := 0.0
var hull: Sprite2D
var turret: Sprite2D
var smoke: GPUParticles2D
var flames: CPUParticles2D
var _t := 0.0
# A7 state machine. Only tank.gd writes these three.
var _motion := Motion.IDLE
var _weapon := Weapon.READY
var _fire_ticks := 0             # physics ticks since the press tick (press tick = 0)
var _shot_pos := Vector2.ZERO    # muzzle position captured on the press tick
var _shot_dir := Vector2.ZERO    # aim captured on the press tick
var _hull_tex := {}
var _turret_tex := {}


func _ready() -> void:
	health = max_health
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1 | 2
	var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
	var circle := CircleShape2D.new()
	circle.radius = RADIUS
	shape.shape = circle
	add_child(shape)
	for d in ["right", "down_right", "down", "up", "up_right"]:
		_hull_tex[d] = load("res://assets/game/yunqiz/hull_%s.png" % d)
		_turret_tex[d] = load("res://assets/game/yunqiz/turret_%s.png" % d)
	# A7 clip nodes. DustMount is added before Suspension, so it draws under the hull by tree
	# order (same z_index, earlier sibling first). z_index -1 is avoided: it could sink the dust
	# below the arena ground, which draws at z 0.
	var dust_mount := Node2D.new()
	dust_mount.name = "DustMount"
	dust_mount.visible = false
	add_child(dust_mount)
	var dust := Sprite2D.new()
	dust.name = "Dust"
	dust.texture = load("res://assets/game/fx/track_dust_sheet.png")
	dust.hframes = 4
	dust.vframes = 1
	dust.frame = 0
	dust_mount.add_child(dust)
	var suspension := Node2D.new()
	suspension.name = "Suspension"
	add_child(suspension)
	hull = Sprite2D.new()
	hull.scale = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
	suspension.add_child(hull)
	turret = Sprite2D.new()
	turret.scale = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
	turret.position = TURRET_OFFSET
	suspension.add_child(turret)
	var motion_anim := AnimationPlayer.new()
	motion_anim.name = "MotionAnim"
	motion_anim.root_node = NodePath("..")
	motion_anim.callback_mode_process = AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS
	motion_anim.add_animation_library("", load("res://animations/motion_clips.tres"))
	add_child(motion_anim)
	var fire_anim := AnimationPlayer.new()
	fire_anim.name = "FireAnim"
	fire_anim.root_node = NodePath("..")
	fire_anim.callback_mode_process = AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS
	fire_anim.add_animation_library("", load("res://animations/fire_clips.tres"))
	add_child(fire_anim)
	smoke = preload("res://effects/damage_smoke.tscn").instantiate()
	smoke.position = TURRET_OFFSET
	add_child(smoke)
	flames = _make_trail(Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.15, 0.95), Color(0.7, 0.1, 0.0, 0.0), 20, 0.5, -70.0)
	modulate = tint
	_set_sprite(hull, _hull_tex, _slot_for(Vector2.RIGHT.rotated(aim_angle)))
	_set_sprite(turret, _turret_tex, _slot_for(Vector2.RIGHT.rotated(aim_angle)))


func _make_trail(c0: Color, c1: Color, amount: int, life: float, rise: float) -> CPUParticles2D:
	var p := CPUParticles2D.new()
	p.amount = amount
	p.lifetime = life
	p.emitting = false
	p.local_coords = false
	p.position = TURRET_OFFSET
	p.emission_shape = CPUParticles2D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
	p.emission_sphere_radius = 6.0
	p.direction = Vector2(0, -1)
	p.spread = 25.0
	p.gravity = Vector2(0, rise)
	p.initial_velocity_min = 5.0
	p.initial_velocity_max = 15.0
	p.scale_amount_min = 3.0
	p.scale_amount_max = 6.0
	var g := Gradient.new()
	g.set_color(0, c0)
	g.set_color(1, c1)
	p.color_ramp = g
	add_child(p)
	return p


func _slot_for(screen_vec: Vector2) -> int:
	var ground := Vector2(screen_vec.x, screen_vec.y / SIN_E)
	var a := fposmod(ground.angle(), TAU)
	return int(round(a / (PI / 4.0))) % 8


func _set_sprite(s: Sprite2D, tex: Dictionary, slot: int) -> void:
	s.texture = tex[SLOT_TEX[slot]]
	s.flip_h = SLOT_FLIP[slot]


func aim_vec() -> Vector2:
	return Vector2.RIGHT.rotated(aim_angle)


## Muzzle point on the ground plane (shells travel on the ground plane; they are drawn raised).
func muzzle_position() -> Vector2:
	var v := aim_vec()
	var ground := Vector2(v.x, v.y / SIN_E).normalized()
	return global_position + Vector2(ground.x, ground.y * SIN_E) * BARREL_LEN


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	_t += delta
	reload_left = maxf(0.0, reload_left - delta)
	invuln_left = maxf(0.0, invuln_left - delta)
	# Runs before the death return: a shot already committed finishes after death.
	_weapon_tick()
	if is_dead:
		_update_motion()
		return
	_think(delta)
	_update_motion()
	velocity = move_dir * speed
	move_and_slide()
	if move_dir != Vector2.ZERO:
		_set_sprite(hull, _hull_tex, _slot_for(move_dir))
	_set_sprite(turret, _turret_tex, _slot_for(aim_vec()))
	recoil = maxf(0.0, recoil - delta * 20.0)
	# Moving state: track rumble. Idle state: slight engine shake.
	var wobble := Vector2(0, sin(_t * 30.0) * 0.6) if move_dir != Vector2.ZERO else Vector2(0, sin(_t * 12.0) * 0.2)
	var kick := -aim_vec() * recoil
	hull.position = wobble + kick
	turret.position = TURRET_OFFSET + wobble + kick


func _ticks_for_frame(frame: int) -> int:
	return int(round(frame * Engine.physics_ticks_per_second / SHOOT_FPS))


## Motion machine: IDLE <-> MOVING. Starts and stops MotionAnim; owns DustMount position/visible.
func _update_motion() -> void:
	var moving := not is_dead and move_dir != Vector2.ZERO
	var mount: Node2D = get_node("DustMount")
	if moving:
		var behind := -move_dir.normalized() * DUST_BEHIND
		mount.position = Vector2(behind.x, behind.y * SIN_E)
	if moving and _motion == Motion.IDLE:
		_motion = Motion.MOVING
		mount.visible = true
		get_node("MotionAnim").play("track_dust")
	elif not moving and _motion == Motion.MOVING:
		_motion = Motion.IDLE
		mount.visible = false
		get_node("MotionAnim").stop()


## Weapon machine: FIRING -> READY. The shell, muzzle FX and fire sound come out on the active
## tick (frame 1), read from a tick counter and not from the clip.
func _weapon_tick() -> void:
	if _weapon != Weapon.FIRING:
		return
	_fire_ticks += 1
	if _fire_ticks == _ticks_for_frame(SHOOT_ACTIVE_FRAME) and world != null:
		var pos := _shot_pos
		world.spawn_shell(self, pos, _shot_dir)
		world.spawn_fx("muzzle", pos + TURRET_OFFSET)
		_play_fire_sound()
		fired.emit(self)
	if _fire_ticks >= _ticks_for_frame(SHOOT_END_FRAME):
		_weapon = Weapon.READY


## Overridden by the player (input) and the enemies (AI).
func _think(_delta: float) -> void:
	pass


## Fires if the reload timer allows it. The reload check is what stops double triggers:
## no shell and no sound while reloading.
func try_fire() -> bool:
	if is_dead or _weapon == Weapon.FIRING or reload_left > 0.0 or world == null:
		return false
	reload_left = reload_time
	recoil = 3.0
	_weapon = Weapon.FIRING
	_fire_ticks = 0
	_shot_pos = muzzle_position()
	_shot_dir = aim_vec()
	get_node("FireAnim").play("shoot")
	return true


func _play_fire_sound() -> void:
	world.audio.play("fire")


func _play_hit_sound() -> void:
	world.audio.play("player_hit")


## A short invulnerability window ignores repeat hits; the fatal hit plays the explosion only.
func take_damage(amount: int, _from: Node = null) -> void:
	if is_dead or invuln_left > 0.0:
		return
	invuln_left = 0.3
	health = maxi(0, health - amount)
	if health <= 0:
		die()
		return
	_flash()
	if world:
		_play_hit_sound()
	_update_damage_look()
	damaged.emit(self, amount)


## is_dead is set before anything else, so die() can only run once.
func die() -> void:
	if is_dead:
		return
	is_dead = true
	health = 0
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	modulate = Color(0.32, 0.3, 0.28)
	flames.emitting = false
	smoke.emitting = true
	smoke.follow(0.0, true)
	if world:
		world.spawn_fx("explosion", global_position + TURRET_OFFSET)
		world.shake(6.0)
		world.audio.play("explode")
	destroyed.emit(self)


func _update_damage_look() -> void:
	var r := float(health) / float(max_health)
	smoke.follow(r, is_dead)
	flames.emitting = r <= 0.3


func _flash() -> void:
	modulate = Color(2.2, 2.2, 2.2)
	create_tween().tween_property(self, "modulate", tint, 0.15)


func reset_full(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	global_position = pos
	health = max_health
	is_dead = false
	reload_left = 0.0
	invuln_left = 1.0
	modulate = tint
	smoke.emitting = false
	flames.emitting = false

3	## Drives the real scenes/main.tscn through the real loop; input only via Input.parse_input_event.
4	## Run: bash scripts/run-test.sh test_pins.gd 60
5	##
6	## Tick convention. The script resumes on physics_frame, which fires at the start of physics tick i,
7	## before the nodes run tick i. Input injected at resume i is therefore seen by tick i. State read at
8	## resume i is the result of tick i-1, so an observed change is credited to tick i-1.
9	## Ticks are printed relative to the tick "fire" is injected (press tick = 0).
10	
11	const FIRE_TICK := 40      # drive right ticks 0-29, release at 30, idle 30-39, press fire at 40
12	const MOVE_TICKS := 30
13	const HOLD_TICKS := 120
14	const TAIL_TICKS := 12
15	# Input.parse_input_event is buffered: an action injected at the start of tick i is seen by the game
16	# on tick i+1 (measured, PIN-0). "Press tick" below means the tick the game first sees the press,
17	# i.e. FIRE_TICK + INPUT_LATENCY, which is the tick try_fire() runs on.
18	const INPUT_LATENCY := 1
19	# A7 re-pin: the brief's phase table puts the shell, muzzle FX and fire sound on frame 1 at
20	# 30 fps = 2 physics ticks at 60 Hz. Before A7 this was 0 (the first pins commit).
21	const SHOT_DELAY_TICKS := 2

23	var passed := 0
24	var failed := 0
25	
26	
27	func _initialize() -> void:
28		_run.call_deferred()
29	
30	
31	func _pin(name: String, measured, expected) -> void:
32		var ok: bool = measured == expected
33		print("%s  %s | measured=%s expected=%s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", name, str(measured), str(expected)])
34		if ok:
35			passed += 1
36		else:
37			failed += 1

40	func _info(text: String) -> void:

42

44	func _inject(action: String, pressed: bool) -> void:
45		var ev := InputEventAction.new()
46		ev.action = action
47		ev.pressed = pressed
48		ev.strength = 1.0
49		Input.parse_input_event(ev)

52	func _shell_ids(fx_layer: Node, shell_script: Script) -> Array:
53		var ids := []
54		for n in fx_layer.get_children():
55			if n.get_script() == shell_script:
56				ids.append(n.get_instance_id())

62		root.add_child(main)
63		await process_frame
64		await physics_frame
65		var player = main.player
66		var audio = main.audio
67		var shell_script: Script = load("res://scripts/shell.gd")
68	
69		# Keep the enemies still and silent without removing anything from physics: target = null makes
70		# enemy _think() return with move_dir = ZERO before any fire call.
71		var enemy_start := []
72		for e in main.enemies:
73			e.target = null
74			enemy_start.append(e.global_position)
75	
76		# Settle a few ticks so the first scripted tick starts from a quiet game.
77		for i in 5:

79		_info("start: player at %s, reload_left=%s, move_dir=%s, fire sounds so far=%d" % [
80			str(player.global_position), str(player.reload_left), str(player.move_dir), audio.count("fire")])
81	
82		var events := []              # [relative tick, label]
83		var shell_ticks := []         # relative ticks a new shell was first seen
84		var sound_ticks := []         # relative ticks the fire sound count rose
85		var seen_ids := _shell_ids(main.fx_layer, shell_script)
86		var all_from_player := true
87		var prev_moving: bool = player.move_dir != Vector2.ZERO
88		var prev_sounds: int = audio.count("fire")
89		var press_physics_frame := -1
90		var first_shell_physics_frame := -1
91		var injected_visible := false
92		var move_start_abs := -1
93		var total := FIRE_TICK + HOLD_TICKS + TAIL_TICKS
94	
95		for i in total:
96			await physics_frame            # start of tick i
97			var abs_tick: int = i - 1                  # tick i-1 produced what we read now
98			var effect_tick: int = abs_tick - FIRE_TICK - INPUT_LATENCY   # relative to the press tick
99			if i > 0:

101				if moving != prev_moving:
102					if moving and move_start_abs < 0:
103						move_start_abs = abs_tick
104					events.append([effect_tick, "move_start" if moving else "move_stop"])
105					prev_moving = moving
106				for n in main.fx_layer.get_children():
107					if n.get_script() == shell_script and not seen_ids.has(n.get_instance_id()):
108						seen_ids.append(n.get_instance_id())
109						events.append([effect_tick, "shell"])
110						shell_ticks.append(effect_tick)
111						if n.shooter != player:
112							all_from_player = false
113						if first_shell_physics_frame < 0:

115				var sounds: int = audio.count("fire")

123			elif i == MOVE_TICKS:
124				_inject("move_right", false)
125			elif i == FIRE_TICK:
126				_inject("fire", true)
127				press_physics_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames()
128				injected_visible = Input.is_action_pressed("fire")
129			elif i == FIRE_TICK + HOLD_TICKS:

133		# tick; each later tick subtracts delta first, and try_fire needs reload_left <= 0.
134		var delta := 1.0 / float(Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)
135		var r := 0.8
136		var expected_reload := 0
137		while r > 0.0:
138			r = maxf(0.0, r - delta)
139			expected_reload += 1
140	
141		print("---- measured sequence (tick relative to the fire press; move ticks are negative) ----")
142		for ev in events:
143			print("  tick %4d  %s" % [ev[0], ev[1]])
144		_info("fire sound ticks: %s" % str(sound_ticks))
145		_info("Engine.get_physics_frames at press injection=%d, when first shell was seen=%d" % [
146			press_physics_frame, first_shell_physics_frame])
147		_info("nominal reload: 0.8 s * 60 = 48 ticks; arithmetic of the code (float, delta=1/60) gives %d" % expected_reload)
148		print("---- pins ----")
149	
150		_pin("PIN-0 input latency: ticks from injecting move_right (tick 0) to the tick the game acts on it",
151			move_start_abs, INPUT_LATENCY)
152		_pin("PIN-0b Input.is_action_pressed is still false right after parse_input_event (buffered)",
153			injected_visible, false)
154		var expected_events := [
155			[-FIRE_TICK, "move_start"],
156			[-(FIRE_TICK - MOVE_TICKS), "move_stop"],
157			[SHOT_DELAY_TICKS, "shell"],
158			[SHOT_DELAY_TICKS + expected_reload, "shell"],
159			[SHOT_DELAY_TICKS + 2 * expected_reload, "shell"],
160		]
161		_pin("PIN-1 sequence of move_dir changes and shells", str(events), str(expected_events))
162		_pin("PIN-2 first shell tick vs press [RE-PINNED A7: shell on frame 1 = +2 ticks]",
163			shell_ticks[0] if shell_ticks.size() > 0 else -999, SHOT_DELAY_TICKS)
164		var interval: int = (shell_ticks[1] - shell_ticks[0]) if shell_ticks.size() > 1 else -999
165		_pin("PIN-3 reload interval, ticks between shell 1 and 2 while fire held", interval, expected_reload)
166		_pin("PIN-3b shells during the 120-tick hold", shell_ticks.size(), 3)
167		_pin("PIN-4 fire sound tick vs press [RE-PINNED A7: shell on frame 1 = +2 ticks]; observed through audio.count(\"fire\"), no script edited",
168			sound_ticks[0] if sound_ticks.size() > 0 else -999, SHOT_DELAY_TICKS)
169		_pin("PIN-4b fire sound requests over the run (one per shell)", sound_ticks.size(), shell_ticks.size())
170		_pin("PIN-5 every shell belongs to the player", all_from_player, true)
171		var enemies_still := true
172		for k in main.enemies.size():
173			if main.enemies[k].global_position != enemy_start[k] or main.enemies[k].move_dir != Vector2.ZERO:
174				enemies_still = false
175		_pin("PIN-6 enemies did not move (target = null)", enemies_still, true)
176		_pin("PIN-7 player stayed alive", player.is_dead, false)

extends SceneTree
## A7 Step 2 pins: what the game does NOW, before any clip is wired.
## Drives the real scenes/main.tscn through the real loop; input only via Input.parse_input_event.
## Run: bash scripts/run-test.sh test_pins.gd 60
##
## Tick convention. The script resumes on physics_frame, which fires at the start of physics tick i,
## before the nodes run tick i. Input injected at resume i is therefore seen by tick i. State read at
## resume i is the result of tick i-1, so an observed change is credited to tick i-1.
## Ticks are printed relative to the tick "fire" is injected (press tick = 0).

const FIRE_TICK := 40      # drive right ticks 0-29, release at 30, idle 30-39, press fire at 40
const MOVE_TICKS := 30
const HOLD_TICKS := 120
const TAIL_TICKS := 12
# Input.parse_input_event is buffered: an action injected at the start of tick i is seen by the game
# on tick i+1 (measured, PIN-0). "Press tick" below means the tick the game first sees the press,
# i.e. FIRE_TICK + INPUT_LATENCY, which is the tick try_fire() runs on.
const INPUT_LATENCY := 1
# A7 re-pin: the brief's phase table puts the shell, muzzle FX and fire sound on frame 1 at
# 30 fps = 2 physics ticks at 60 Hz. Before A7 this was 0 (the first pins commit).
const SHOT_DELAY_TICKS := 2

var passed := 0
var failed := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _pin(name: String, measured, expected) -> void:
	var ok: bool = measured == expected
	print("%s  %s | measured=%s expected=%s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", name, str(measured), str(expected)])
	if ok:
		passed += 1
	else:
		failed += 1


func _info(text: String) -> void:
	print("INFO  " + text)


func _inject(action: String, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventAction.new()
	ev.action = action
	ev.pressed = pressed
	ev.strength = 1.0
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)


func _shell_ids(fx_layer: Node, shell_script: Script) -> Array:
	var ids := []
	for n in fx_layer.get_children():
		if n.get_script() == shell_script:
			ids.append(n.get_instance_id())
	return ids


func _run() -> void:
	var main = load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	await process_frame
	await physics_frame
	var player = main.player
	var audio = main.audio
	var shell_script: Script = load("res://scripts/shell.gd")

	# Keep the enemies still and silent without removing anything from physics: target = null makes
	# enemy _think() return with move_dir = ZERO before any fire call.
	var enemy_start := []
	for e in main.enemies:
		e.target = null
		enemy_start.append(e.global_position)

	# Settle a few ticks so the first scripted tick starts from a quiet game.
	for i in 5:
		await physics_frame
	_info("start: player at %s, reload_left=%s, move_dir=%s, fire sounds so far=%d" % [
		str(player.global_position), str(player.reload_left), str(player.move_dir), audio.count("fire")])

	var events := []              # [relative tick, label]
	var shell_ticks := []         # relative ticks a new shell was first seen
	var sound_ticks := []         # relative ticks the fire sound count rose
	var seen_ids := _shell_ids(main.fx_layer, shell_script)
	var all_from_player := true
	var prev_moving: bool = player.move_dir != Vector2.ZERO
	var prev_sounds: int = audio.count("fire")
	var press_physics_frame := -1
	var first_shell_physics_frame := -1
	var injected_visible := false
	var move_start_abs := -1
	var total := FIRE_TICK + HOLD_TICKS + TAIL_TICKS

	for i in total:
		await physics_frame            # start of tick i
		var abs_tick: int = i - 1                  # tick i-1 produced what we read now
		var effect_tick: int = abs_tick - FIRE_TICK - INPUT_LATENCY   # relative to the press tick
		if i > 0:
			var moving: bool = player.move_dir != Vector2.ZERO
			if moving != prev_moving:
				if moving and move_start_abs < 0:
					move_start_abs = abs_tick
				events.append([effect_tick, "move_start" if moving else "move_stop"])
				prev_moving = moving
			for n in main.fx_layer.get_children():
				if n.get_script() == shell_script and not seen_ids.has(n.get_instance_id()):
					seen_ids.append(n.get_instance_id())
					events.append([effect_tick, "shell"])
					shell_ticks.append(effect_tick)
					if n.shooter != player:
						all_from_player = false
					if first_shell_physics_frame < 0:
						first_shell_physics_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames()
			var sounds: int = audio.count("fire")
			if sounds != prev_sounds:
				for k in sounds - prev_sounds:
					sound_ticks.append(effect_tick)
				prev_sounds = sounds
		# Injection for tick i.
		if i == 0:
			_inject("move_right", true)
		elif i == MOVE_TICKS:
			_inject("move_right", false)
		elif i == FIRE_TICK:
			_inject("fire", true)
			press_physics_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames()
			injected_visible = Input.is_action_pressed("fire")
		elif i == FIRE_TICK + HOLD_TICKS:
			_inject("fire", false)

	# Expected reload interval from the code's own arithmetic: reload_left = 0.8 is set on the shot
	# tick; each later tick subtracts delta first, and try_fire needs reload_left <= 0.
	var delta := 1.0 / float(Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)
	var r := 0.8
	var expected_reload := 0
	while r > 0.0:
		r = maxf(0.0, r - delta)
		expected_reload += 1

	print("---- measured sequence (tick relative to the fire press; move ticks are negative) ----")
	for ev in events:
		print("  tick %4d  %s" % [ev[0], ev[1]])
	_info("fire sound ticks: %s" % str(sound_ticks))
	_info("Engine.get_physics_frames at press injection=%d, when first shell was seen=%d" % [
		press_physics_frame, first_shell_physics_frame])
	_info("nominal reload: 0.8 s * 60 = 48 ticks; arithmetic of the code (float, delta=1/60) gives %d" % expected_reload)
	print("---- pins ----")

	_pin("PIN-0 input latency: ticks from injecting move_right (tick 0) to the tick the game acts on it",
		move_start_abs, INPUT_LATENCY)
	_pin("PIN-0b Input.is_action_pressed is still false right after parse_input_event (buffered)",
		injected_visible, false)
	var expected_events := [
		[-FIRE_TICK, "move_start"],
		[-(FIRE_TICK - MOVE_TICKS), "move_stop"],
		[SHOT_DELAY_TICKS, "shell"],
		[SHOT_DELAY_TICKS + expected_reload, "shell"],
		[SHOT_DELAY_TICKS + 2 * expected_reload, "shell"],
	]
	_pin("PIN-1 sequence of move_dir changes and shells", str(events), str(expected_events))
	_pin("PIN-2 first shell tick vs press [RE-PINNED A7: shell on frame 1 = +2 ticks]",
		shell_ticks[0] if shell_ticks.size() > 0 else -999, SHOT_DELAY_TICKS)
	var interval: int = (shell_ticks[1] - shell_ticks[0]) if shell_ticks.size() > 1 else -999
	_pin("PIN-3 reload interval, ticks between shell 1 and 2 while fire held", interval, expected_reload)
	_pin("PIN-3b shells during the 120-tick hold", shell_ticks.size(), 3)
	_pin("PIN-4 fire sound tick vs press [RE-PINNED A7: shell on frame 1 = +2 ticks]; observed through audio.count(\"fire\"), no script edited",
		sound_ticks[0] if sound_ticks.size() > 0 else -999, SHOT_DELAY_TICKS)
	_pin("PIN-4b fire sound requests over the run (one per shell)", sound_ticks.size(), shell_ticks.size())
	_pin("PIN-5 every shell belongs to the player", all_from_player, true)
	var enemies_still := true
	for k in main.enemies.size():
		if main.enemies[k].global_position != enemy_start[k] or main.enemies[k].move_dir != Vector2.ZERO:
			enemies_still = false
	_pin("PIN-6 enemies did not move (target = null)", enemies_still, true)
	_pin("PIN-7 player stayed alive", player.is_dead, false)

	print("RESULT: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)
